job.title: Consultant Junior à Manager RH / SIRH secteur public (H/F) @ BearingPoint (Courbevoie, A8, FR)
job.description:
Vos missions en tant que consultant RH / SIRH dans le secteur public :

Au cœur des transformations, la fonction Ressources Humaines doit se réinventer, afin de mieux soutenir la mise en œuvre des politiques publiques et intégrer les nouvelles attentes des agents publics. Elle doit donc se positionner comme acteur stratégique des organisations publiques, pour accompagner au mieux les réformes et réussir sa propre transformation. Innovation, attractivité, performance, prédictivité, agilité sont autant de défis auxquels les DRH doivent aujourd’hui répondre.

BearingPoint accompagne les DRH des organisations publiques, dans leurs projets de transformation, et ce sur l’ensemble de la chaine de valeur RH :

* Construire des stratégies et des politiques RH adaptées aux enjeux des organisations publiques,
* Optimiser les organisations RH et les processus RH,
* Construire et mettre en œuvre des stratégies digitales RH et schémas directeurs SIRH,
* Accompagner le déploiement de nouveaux outils RH (SIRH, Gen AI…).

A titre d'exemples, nous avons récemment mené les missions suivantes :

* Auditer l’organisation de la fonction RH d’un établissement public et revoir l’ensemble des processus RH,
* Accompagner la transformation SIRH d’un ministère, du schéma directeur jusqu’au déploiement des nouveaux outils,
* Accompagner la préparation des élections professionnelles dans plusieurs ministères,
* Réaliser un baromètre social pour une collectivité territoriale.

En fonction de votre profil et de vos appétences, vous pourrez intégrer l’équipe People & Strategy (expertise RH/SIRH) ou l’équipe Public & Health Services (expertise secteur public).

Votre profil

Nous recrutons à tous les grades :

* que vous soyez récemment diplômé(e) d’une grande école d’ingénieur, de commerce ou d’université, avec une spécialité en Droit public et/ou en Ressources Humaines,
* ou que vous ayez déjà une expérience significative dans le secteur du conseil et/ou dans le secteur Public et/ou en Ressources Humaines / gestion de projet SI.

job.title: Research Project Manager (1,0 fte) @ Universiteit Leiden (Leiden, ZH, NL)
job.description:
Job requisition Id: 16970

Job type: Non-academic staff

Contract hours min: 32

Contract hours max: 38

Location: Leiden

Applying is possible until: 4 november 2026

  

**Teaser Text**
---------------

Are you excited about managing complex research and valorisation projects while also building new relationships with researchers and support staff? If so, this unique role is for you.

**What you will do**
--------------------

As Research Project Manager you are part of the Research Project Management Pool, a team of dedicated project managers at Luris. In the role you will plan, organise and manage research projects, supporting researchers in different phases of the project lifecycle. Additionally, you will support the team with its outreach and project acquisition activities.

  

Along with the other project managers in the pool, you will:

  

* Coordinate the execution of research and valorisation projects in close collaboration with the Principal Investigator/ Project Lead.
* Monitor and report progress and budget, ensuring compliance with the funding agency requirements, agreed contracts and policies.
* Assist with all aspects of the projects’ contractual documentation, including change requests, amendments, and the drafting of other agreements as required.
* Maintain relationships with consortium partners, controllers, funders and other key stakeholders.
* Support the development of acquisition strategies for new projects and promote the new project management pool across the university.
  

In addition to your role in the pool, you will be a part of the active and lively Leiden Research Support Network, the wider community of research project managers and of course the Luris team. All in all, an interesting and exciting opportunity for someone with a passion for research support.

**Where you will work**
-----------------------

Luris creates and facilitates the network between Leiden scientists and public and private partners, with a focus on generating societal impact through research, knowledge and innovation. We support scientists at Leiden University and the LUMC in their ambition to further develop their research. To achieve this goal, we work closely with academics, companies and many other stakeholders in the Leiden ecosystem.

  

As a team our aim is to help researchers plan, organise and manage complex or interdisciplinary research projects. You will start in a position as Project Manager for a National Growth Fund project and a Dutch Research Agenda (NWA) project.

**What you bring**
------------------

The Luris Research Project Management Pool is looking for a proactive and enthusiastic colleague to join our growing team. You are enterprising, team- and service-oriented and able to establish and maintain professional relationships. You feel comfortable in the role of a coordinator and sparring partner for (a diverse group of) researchers. You also enjoy engaging in dialogue and collaborating with public sector organisations, such as government ministries, and other societal stakeholders. With your analytical mindset, you are able to quickly assess what is going on. You take ownership of your work, are driven by results, and feel confident working independently while shaping your own responsibilities. Your communication style is clear and approachable, and you are not deterred by deadlines.

  

In addition, you have:

  

* Master, or comparable experience.
* Knowledge of externally funded research projects and the national/ international funding landscape, especially NWO, or other Dutch funding opportunities.
* Work experience in a research support role within an academic/ research environment.
* Good communication skills.
* Excellent command of both the Dutch and English language, both verbally and in writing.
  

If you immediately recognise yourself in this profile, or if do you not quite meet all the requirements, but you believe that this is the right job for you, we look forward to your application!

**What we offer**
-----------------

Our goal is to work together to create a transparent and inclusive work environment in which everyone feels welcome and appreciated. Our organisation is always evolving and we need your ideas for improvement and innovation to take us further. We want to devote attention to your personal development.

  

You can count on an enjoyable job within the socially relevant world of education and research. The University's challenging and international work environment is located just steps away from Leiden’s lively city centre or the bustling city centre of The Hague *.* We also want to work with you to devote attention to your health and vitality, for example with the fun activities we organise through Healthy University.

  

We also offer:

  

* An employment contract for the duration of one year with a view to permanent employment based on performance. This contract falls under the CLA of Dutch Universities;
* A salary of a minimum of € 3706 and a maximum of € 6682 gross per month, based on a full-time appointment (38 hours) (scale 10 -11);
* A holiday allowance (8%), an end-of-year bonus (8,3%), and an attractive pension scheme at ABP;
* Full reimbursement of public transport commuting costs for home-to-work travel;
* Flexible working hours: as a standard, you are entitled to a minimum of 29 leave days on the basis of a full-time working week of 38 hours; you can also save for extra leave, for example by working 40 hours a week, and in this way accrue an extra 96 leave hours, or exchange 96 leave hours for a 36-hour week.
* Lots of options when it comes to secondary employment conditions; we can, for example, discuss options for a sabbatical or paid parental leave. Within our terms of employment individual choices model, you can exchange leave days and/or salary for benefits such as an advantageous sports subscription and bicycle scheme;
* If your work allows it, hybrid working is possible within the Netherlands;
* A home-working allowance (day and internet allowance) and attention for good workplaces. The University will also provide you with a laptop and a mobile telephone.
  

For more information about employment conditions, see https://www.universiteitleiden.nl/werken-bij/sollicitatieprocedure-en-arbeidsvoorwaarden

**What we value**
-----------------

Promoting an inclusive community is central to Leiden University’s values and vision. We strive to be an open community in which all students and staff members feel valued and respected, and are able to fully develop themselves. We consider an inclusive academic environment, where students and staff can share their experiences and viewpoints, to be essential for the development of talent.

**Want to apply or find out more?**
-----------------------------------

If you want to apply straight away, click the application button.  

If you would like more information about what the job entails, please contact Elka Smith, Team Lead - Research Project Management Pool, at e.s.smith@luris.nl. You can apply until 04 November 2026; You will receive a response to your application no later than three weeks after the vacancy closing date.

  

To help us get to know each other better, we follow a number of steps in the application procedure. For more information, see https://www.universiteitleiden.nl/werken-bij/sollicitatieprocedure-en-arbeidsvoorwaarden

  

* In choosing between candidates, in case of equal suitability, preference will be given to internal candidates, women, the occupationally disabled and employees with a migration background.
* A pre-employment screening (references, diplomas, certificate of good conduct (VOG)) may be part of the selection procedure.
* You live and are officially registered as resident in The Netherlands or are willing to relocate upon starting the position.
  

* *Acquisition in response to this vacancy is not appreciated. If you nevertheless choose to send us CVs, no rights can be derived from this.* **#LI-Hybrid**

  

Information at a Glance

Faculty / Unit: Luris

Contact with (Name + position): Elka Smith, Team Lead - Research Project Management Pool

Contact Email address: e.s.smith@luris.nl

job.title: Process Manager – Project Execution Manager @ Hilti Group (Berkel en Rodenrijs, ZH, NL)
job.description:
* Berkel en Rodenrijs, South Holland, The Netherlands
* Project & Process Management
* Experienced Professionals
* 21729

  

**Planning that predicts. Delivery that performs.**
---------------------------------------------------

Are you ready to join a pioneering team, contribute to the growth of our Project Business, and shape the future of project execution? In this role you will create and improve global standards, processes, procedures, and guidelines that enable successful Project Business execution. From initiation and development through piloting, implementation, training, rollout, and post-rollout support, you will collaborate across functions, including Logistics, IT, and other business units, to develop effective end-to-end solutions across the construction workflow.
  
  
Required travel for this role is up to 20%.

**What You'll do**
------------------

* Shaping processes and strategic initiatives in the development, piloting, implementation and rollout of new global standards, processes and the system landscape for Large Project Execution
* Drive continuous improvement by documenting, training and further developing established global standards and best practices.
* Collaborate across functions and geographies, working closely with Logistics areas including Materials Management, Prefabrication, Warehousing, Transport, Services, Reporting & Controlling, as well as IT, LP Acquisition, BUFPS, Marketing and Finance, to develop seamless end-to-end business solutions.
* Drive internal benchmarking and best-practice sharing, supporting regional line managers in successfully adopting and implementing global best practices.
* Act as a trusted business partner and key global Logistics contact within Large Project Execution supporting regions in solving operational management challenges.
* Support LEAN initiatives, including Kaizen and Value Stream Mapping (VSM), and contribute your expertise to cross-functional improvement projects and strategies, identifying more efficient solutions with a strong focus on seamless end-to-end processes.
* Develop and deliver training and capability-building programs.

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

To help you succeed, we’ll provide you with everything you need so that we’re driving impact together from day one. You’ll find a stable working environment, exceptional support, learning and development, and a great team around you. Here’s what you’ll need to bring with you:

* Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field; a Master’s degree is an advantage
* A recognized project management certification, such as PMP.
* A minimum of eight years of hands-on experience in project management, process improvement, or operational excellence within the construction industry
* Proven ability to develop, implement, and continuously improve global processes, standards, procedures, frameworks, and governance structures
* Strong analytical experience in assessing end-to-end workflows, identifying bottlenecks and root causes, and translating data and operational insights into practical, measurable improvements
* Demonstrated experience in process optimization, KPI definition and analysis, performance measurement, and business case development
* Experience in developing and delivering training and capability-building programs, with strong stakeholder management and communication skills, and the ability to translate hands-on project experience into scalable concepts, standards, and ways of working that shape project execution across the organization.

**What’s In It for You**
------------------------

We really value our people, and we've worked hard to develop a reward package that reflects this, creating your future to be just how you would want it. Some of our benefits include:

* Competitive salary and bonus scheme
* Mobility allowance plus ability to claim your kilometers.
* 25 holidays + 3 additional days and 2 additional days if you are not sick during the year.
* A fully paid contribution free pension scheme.
* Free use of our shuttle bus from the metro station to the office.
* Hybrid working environment with options of working 2 days remotely.
* For expats the ability to work from your home country for 3 weeks/ year to be close to family.
* Bike and gym services.
* Possibility to develop further within the organization

  
We have a very thorough people review process, unlike any we know of in any other business. We can pair talent with opportunities - developing our people in their current roles or challenging them to work in new ways or in new places. It’s how we find the right fit, further our teams personally and professionally, get the best value for each employee, and increase the job satisfaction. Additionally, we offer you a wide range of benefits.  
  

**Why Hilti**
-------------

Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.
  
  
Learn more about our recruitment process: Prepare for your Hilti-Interview

**Commitment to Inclusion**
---------------------------

At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

For further questions, please feel free to contact Alberto Domingues, Head of Logistics Large Project Execution (Alberto.dominguez@hilti.com) or for process related questions you can contact Nicolette Spanjersberg, Talent Acquisition Business Partner (Nicolette.spanjersberg@hilti.com).

job.title: Manager Strategy & Compliance @ RENT A PIN B.V. (Amsterdam Zuid, NH, NL)
job.description:
**Over RENT A PIN**

RENT A PIN is een betaalinstelling met een vergunning van De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB). We focussen op betaalterminalverhuur en transactieverwerkingen met geweldige service. We zijn klein genoeg om snel te schakelen en werken in een sector waarin ondernemerschap en strenge regelgeving elkaar dagelijks raken.

**De functie**

Hoe laat je een betaaldienstverlener groeien in een markt waarin elke strategische stap ook langs de toezichthouder moet? Dat is de kernvraag van deze rol.

Je werkt rechtstreeks met de directeur en krijgt veel ruimte om je rol zelf in te vullen. Je ziet kansen, werkt ze uit tot onderbouwde voorstellen en zorgt dat ze ook echt worden uitgevoerd. Daarnaast ben je het gezicht van RENT A PIN richting toezichthouders, banken en betaalpartners. De functie is nadrukkelijk bedoeld als opstap: wie zich bewijst, groeit door.

**Wat ga je doen?**

**Strategie en groei**

* Je denkt mee over de koers van RENT A PIN en onderzoekt nieuwe producten, markten, businessmodellen en samenwerkingen.
* Je vertaalt kansen naar concrete voorstellen, inclusief wat ze operationeel en juridisch vragen, en trekt de uitvoering.
* Je ziet waar de organisatie zelf beter kan en pakt dat op.

**Relaties met toezichthouders en partners**

* Je onderhoudt en versterkt de relaties met DNB, banken, acquirers en andere betaalpartners.
* Je voert de inhoudelijke gesprekken met externe stakeholders en neemt waar passend de regie over deze contacten.
* Je coördineert trajecten met externe stakeholders en zorgt dat afspraken en toezeggingen worden nagekomen.

**Commercie en regelgeving verbinden**

* Je doorgrondt wat wet- en regelgeving, en de interpretatie daarvan, betekent voor de mogelijkheden van RENT A PIN.
* Samen met de compliance officer en andere specialisten bepaal je wat wel en niet kan, en zoek je naar oplossingen wanneer regels een initiatief in de weg staan.
* Je helpt de directie tot goed onderbouwde besluiten te komen door kritisch te zijn, en de juiste vragen te stellen.

Je hoeft geen jurist of compliance officer te zijn. Wel moet je het leuk vinden om je in complexe regels vast te bijten, zodat je goed beslagen ten ijs komt in gesprekken met specialisten en toezichthouder. Je neemt een interpretatie van wet- en regelgeving niet zomaar voor waar aan: je durft een strenge lezing van de regels te challengen, met argumenten, en zoekt naar de ruimte die er binnen de kaders wél is.

**Je eigen koers**

* Je bepaalt zelf je prioriteiten en betrekt de directeur bij besluiten die dat vragen.
* Je haalt externe expertise of capaciteit binnen waar dat nodig is.
* Naarmate je groeit, breid je je verantwoordelijkheden uit, mogelijk met het opbouwen van een commercieel team.

**Wat vinden we belangrijk?**

Je hoeft niet vanaf dag één alle antwoorden te hebben. Belangrijker is dat je je nieuwe onderwerpen snel eigen maakt, verantwoordelijkheid durft te nemen en begrijpt dat goede besluiten zowel ondernemerschap als zorgvuldigheid vragen. Concreet betekent dat:

* Je denkt ondernemend en ziet waar de organisatie commercieel en strategisch verder kan.
* Je vindt het interessant hoe wetten en regels in de praktijk werken en welke ruimte ze laten.
* Je bent analytisch sterk en vertaalt complexe materie naar concrete keuzes.
* Je weegt kansen af tegen risico’s en wettelijke verplichtingen.
* Je legt makkelijk contact, van toezichthouder tot klant, en bouwt relaties voor de lange termijn.
* Je werkt zelfstandig en weet wanneer je zelf beslist en wanneer je afstemt.
* Je hebt de ambitie om op termijn eindverantwoordelijk te zijn voor een onderneming.
* Je hebt [hbo/wo]-werk- en denkniveau.

Ervaring in betalingsverkeer, financiële dienstverlening, compliance of business development is mooi meegenomen.

**Wat bieden we?**

* Een brede rol met directe invloed op de strategie van RENT A PIN.
* Veel vrijheid om je functie zelf vorm te geven.
* Korte lijnen met de directeur en betrokkenheid bij alle belangrijke beslissingen.
* Een doorgroeimogelijkheid naar een directiefunctie. *Goed om te weten: wie bij een betaalinstelling directeur wordt, wordt vooraf door DNB getoetst op betrouwbaarheid en geschiktheid. Die toetsing hoort bij de doorgroeistap.*
* Salarisindicatie: € 8.750 – €10.000 bruto per maand voor 40 uur per week.

**Interesse?**

Wil je niet alleen meedenken, maar ook zelf kansen zien, keuzes maken en ze waarmaken? Dan maken we graag kennis.

**Stuur je cv en motivatie naar lizabalk@rap.nl. Vertel ons daarin vooral hoe jij commerciële groei zou combineren met de eisen die aan een betaalinstelling worden gesteld. Vragen over de functie? Neem contact met ons op via lizabalk@rap.nl of bel Philippe Vischjager op 020 471 4714.**

Salaris: €8.750,00 - €10.000,00 per maand

Werklocatie: Fysiek

job.title: Tutor Academy TA Technology Strategy 2026/2027 @ Erasmus Universiteit Rotterdam (Rotterdam, ZH, NL)
job.description:
**Introduction**
----------------

Firms need to innovate to stay competitive. Kodak and Nokia are amongst the many examples of companies that paid the price for not keeping up with the market. However, innovation is difficult and while successful innovations promise large returns, many projects fail. This has never been more accurate than in the Digital Age, as fast-paced and complex technologies such as AI now permeate businesses and products.

**Job description**
-------------------

As a TA you will help with the grading of case reports that discuss the transformative impact of digital technologies on businesses and economies. You have the chance to dive deep into the opportunities and challenges of the Digital Revolution and you can practice your own case skills.

You will work for a total of 50h between Dec 2026 and Feb 2027. The case report is assessed during exam (Dec 14 for the exam and Feb 8 for the resit), so you will mostly need to work on the grading after exams, i.e., mid-late Dec and early-mid Feb. There is some flexibility in the allocation of hours.

**Job requirements**
--------------------

* Applicants must be registered in the Netherlands. Applicants must have a Dutch address, a Dutch social security number (“BSN”), and a work permit.
* Applicants must have completed their Bachelor's degree. Applicants must be currently enrolled as a student at the Erasmus university.
* The ideal candidate has attained very good results in previous case-based classes, is a strong writer, and has a very good command of the English language. A background in innovation, technology management, strategy, or economics is a plus.

**Employment conditions and benefits**
--------------------------------------

You will be paid in accordance with the standard university TA contract (around €19 gross hourly rate for Master’s students). Please keep in mind that the salary rate may differ slightly based on the contract that you will receive for the specific vacancy. You will also receive a free didactical training that takes about a day. There will be no monetary compensation for this training, but we aim to provide a high-quality training that, upon completion, can be meaningfully listed on your CV.

**Employer**
------------

Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) is an internationally oriented university with a strong social orientation in its education and research, as expressed in our mission ‘Creating positive societal impact’. EUR is home to 4.100 academics and professionals and almost 33.000 students from more than 140 countries. Everything we do, we do under the credo The Erasmian Way – Making Minds Matter. We’re global citizens, connecting, entrepreneurial, open-minded, and socially involved. These Erasmian Values function as our internal compass and create EUR’s distinctive and recognizable profile. From these values, with a broad perspective and with an eye for diversity, different backgrounds and opinions, our employees work closely together to solve societal challenges from the dynamic and cosmopolitan city of Rotterdam. Thanks to the high quality and positive societal impact of our research and education, EUR can compete with the top European universities. www.eur.nl.

**Faculty / Institute / Central service**
-----------------------------------------

Rotterdam School of Management, Erasmus University (RSM) is one of Europe’s top-ranked business schools. RSM provides ground-breaking research and education furthering excellence in all aspects of management and is based in the international port city of Rotterdam – a vital nexus of business, logistics and trade. RSM’s primary focus is on developing business leaders with international careers who can become a force for positive change by carrying their innovative mindset into a sustainable future. Our first-class range of bachelor, master, MBA, PhD and executive programmes encourage them to become critical, creative, caring and collaborative thinkers and doers.

RSM is an equal opportunity employer and explicitly encourages applications from candidates of all genders, ethnicities, and nationalities.

www.rsm.nl

**Applying**
------------

Please submit your CV, full transcripts of records of all completed university degrees, and a brief motivation the Tutor Academy recruitment platform. If you have previously worked as a TA for the Erasmus University Rotterdam, please include your previous contract start and end dates. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Early application is strongly encouraged. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to reach out to j.tang@rsm.nl or tutoracademy@rsm.nl

job.title: Customer Success Manager @ SAS (Frankfurt am Main, HE, DE)
job.description:
:

**Customer Success Manager- Hybrid, Frankfurt**

We’re a leader in data and AI. Through our software and services, we inspire customers around the world to transform data into intelligence - and questions into answers.

If you're looking for a dynamic, fulfilling career with flexibility and a world-class employee experience, you'll find it here. We're recognized around the world for our inclusive, meaningful culture and innovative technologies by organizations like Fast Company, Forbes, Newsweek and more.

**About the job**

Customer Success isn’t just a department – it’s an ecosystem permeating every corner of our organization. Our Customer Success team is looking for a Customer Success Manager to establish and build broad relationships with SAS customers in the public sector to adopt and expand usage of the SAS software and solutions, to identify new opportunities and engage with other SAS resources to bring the necessary domain and SAS experience to assist with existing SAS implementations and identify new sales opportunities.

**As a Customer Success Manager, you will:**

  

* Serve as primary post-sale point of contact to develop strong customer advocates at all levels of the organization (IT to user to Exec) becoming a trusted advisor to our customers.
* Jointly define success and value activities with our customers by understanding not only the business and/or IT problems they are trying to solve but supporting them in driving business growth, impacting their respective bottom line and helping them succeed in best managing the adoption our software.
* Excel in multi-stakeholder management within your accounts, proactive risk management, product adoption initiatives and customer communications and conflict resolution.
* Work with other SAS stakeholders to develop a comprehensive adoption plan that includes a variety of content, events, email, social media, and innovative campaign approaches.
* Build reports and analytics to provide key business insights used for data driven decision making.
* Lead or assist with gathering CSM requirements for new and ongoing projects and/or requests for supporting systems or artifacts.
* Create and document Customer Success Plans driving accountability with customer and sales towards execution.
* Foster x-functional alignment, sharing insights and content with Sales, Marketing, Product & Professional Services creating a unified customer experience.
* Monitor Customer Success through metrics and other measurements.

**Role Competencies:**

* Account Planning- Establishing a plan to achieve the sales objectives of an account, taking into consideration overall opportunities, customer business priorities and anticipated business changes, regional issues, past sales results, and available resources; taking action specified in the account plan, reviewing progress, and adjusting the plan as needed.
* Building Customer Relationship- Ensuring that the customer’s internal or external needs are met; building productive relationships with high-priority customers; taking accountability for customer satisfaction and loyalty; using appropriate interpersonal techniques to prevent and resolve escalated customer complaints and regain customer confidence.
* Creating Demand Through Insight- Identifying the targeted account’s business challenges and needs and their probable causes; providing and provoking convincing insights that compel decision makers to discover or reconsider unrecognized problems and opportunities and the value of addressing them with new solutions to achieve better long-term results (e.g., profitability, revenue, market share).
* You’re curious, passionate, authentic and accountable. These are our values and influence everything we do.

**Work Location:** Frankfurt, Germany

**Required qualifications**

* Proven experience in Customer Success with a strong track record of building trusted relationships, driving customer value, and supporting long-term customer growth
* Experience with working with a variety of clients , especially in the public sector industry.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute tailored Customer Success plans, building long-term strategic relationships and driving measurable customer outcomes.
* Fluent in English and German, with excellent communication skills in both languages.
* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with a natural ability to build trusted relationships across all organizational levels.
* Self-motivated and adaptable, with the ability to work independently while thriving in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
* Willingness to travel to customer locations as required.
* Ensure all applicable security policies and processes are followed to support the organization's secure software development goals.
* Embrace curiosity, passion, authenticity and accountability. These are our values and influence everything we do.
* Equivalent combination of related education, training and experience may be considered in place of the above qualifications.

**Benefits highlights**

* Highly competitive base salary complemented by an attractive annual bonus scheme.
* Our Recreation and Fitness Center offers recorded fitness classes to help you fit movement into your day.
* SAS supports your well-being with programs that reduce stress and distractions to help you stay healthy and productive.

**You are welcome here.**

At SAS, it’s not about fitting into our culture – it’s about adding to it. We believe our people make the difference. Our inclusive workforce brings together unique talents and inspires teams to create amazing software that reflects the diversity of our users and customers.

**Additional Information:**

*SAS only sends emails from verified “sas.com” email addresses and never asks for sensitive, personal information or money. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any type of communication from, or on behalf of SAS, please contact* *Recruitingsupport@sas.com.*

Let's stay in touch! Join our Talent Community to stay up to date on company news, job updates and more.

#SAS
